title: Suggestion: Multi Window Support
symptom: When using xDrip in multi-window mode on Android, the glucose reading does not update when xDrip is not the focused window, showing stale data. The user wants live data visible at a glance while driving with navigation apps.
cause: The thread suggests that before Android Pie, inactive windows are frozen, and multi-resume windows are only available from Android Pie, causing xDrip to not update when not in focus.
evidence_quote: From my understanding, the multi-resume windows is only available from Android Pie. Before that release , the inactive windows are frozen....
